blocks.title: Everything Has a Name
blocks.body: Look around you. A chair, a dog, a teacher. They all have names!

blocks.question: What do we call a naming word?
blocks.explanation: A noun is a naming word!

blocks.back: A person, place, animal, or thing.

blocks.title: Types of Nouns
blocks.body:
Person: Boy, Girl, Doctor.
Place: Park, School, City.
Animal: Cat, Elephant, Bird.
Thing: Car, Book, Apple.

blocks.question: Which of these is a Place?
blocks.explanation: School is a place you go to!

blocks.title: Noun Test
blocks.body: Can you touch it? Can you go there? Is it alive? Then it's probably a noun!

blocks.title: Proper Nouns
blocks.body: Special names are Proper Nouns and start with a BIG letter! Like 'India', 'Rohan', or 'Sunday'.

blocks.question: Find the noun in this sentence: 'The cat is sleeping.'
blocks.explanation: 'Cat' is an animal, so it is a noun!
